description: This file implements HTTP header handling functions, including creation, sanitization, insertion, search, modification, removal, and tokenization of HTTP headers, using GLib data structures and memory management routines.

external_files.name: liHttpHeader
external_files.description: Represents a single HTTP header with its data and key length.

external_files.name: liHttpHeaders
external_files.description: Container for multiple HTTP headers managed as a queue.

external_files.name: liHttpHeaderTokenizer
external_files.description: Tokenizer for iterating over header values with potential multiple tokens.

external_files.name: li_http_headers_new
external_files.description: Creates a new empty headers collection.

external_files.name: li_http_headers_reset
external_files.description: Resets and clears all headers in the collection.

external_files.name: li_http_header_insert
external_files.description: Inserts a new header, allowing duplicates.

external_files.name: li_http_header_find_first
external_files.description: Finds the first header with a specific key.

external_files.name: li_http_header_find_next
external_files.description: Finds the next header with the same key after a given list node.

external_files.name: li_http_header_find_last
external_files.description: Finds the last header with a specific key.

external_files.name: li_http_header_append
external_files.description: Appends a value to the last occurrence of a header, or inserts if none exists.

external_files.name: li_http_header_overwrite
external_files.description: Overwrites the last occurrence of a header with a new value or inserts if none exists.

external_files.name: li_http_header_remove_link
external_files.description: Removes a header from the collection via its list node.

external_files.name: li_http_header_remove
external_files.description: Removes all headers matching a key.

external_files.name: li_http_header_lookup
external_files.description: Returns the last header with the specified key.

external_files.name: li_http_header_is
external_files.description: Checks if a header with a specific key has a specific value.

external_files.name: li_http_header_get_all
external_files.description: Concatenates all headers with a specific key into a string.

external_files.name: li_http_header_tokenizer_start
external_files.description: Initializes tokenizer to iterate over header tokens for a key.

external_files.name: li_http_header_tokenizer_next
external_files.description: Retrieves the next token from the header value, handling quoted strings and escapes.
